hooks.name: Auto DevLog Writer
hooks.description: Automatically appends a timestamped entry to DEVLOG.md when a Kiro session ends. Logs branch, changed files, and new files. Zero tokens — pure shell.

action.command:
cd /Users/stan/Documents/GitHub/puenzhiyyy && TIMESTAMP=$(date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") && BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown") && CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | head -20 | tr '
' ', ' | sed 's/,$//') && UNTRACKED=$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard 2>/dev/null | head -10 | tr '
' ', ' | sed 's/,$//') && LOGFILE="DEVLOG.md" && if [ ! -f "$LOGFILE" ]; then echo "# Dev Log

Auto-generated session log for StockSense / Rice Inventory MVP.

---
" > "$LOGFILE"; fi && printf "
## Session: %s
- **Branch:** %s
- **Files changed:** %s
- **New files:** %s
- **Notes:** _(add manual notes here)_

---
" "$TIMESTAMP" "$BRANCH" "${CHANGED:-none}" "${UNTRACKED:-none}" >> "$LOGFILE" && echo "DevLog updated at $LOGFILE"
